option_relations.rationale: A mycotic aneurysm is caused by infection, which is not indicated in the vignette. The imaging describes a saccular aneurysm, but not specifically a mycotic one.
Abdominal aortic aneurysm is a broader category that includes the specific saccular, measured aneurysm described in the leaf.

The option 'Large Saccular Aneurysm of the Abdominal Aorta' directly matches the description of the leaf 'Abdominal aortic aneurysm, saccular, 14.6 cm x 12.6 cm x 14.7 cm', with 'large' being consistent with the given dimensions.

A 'Giant Abdominal Aortic Aneurysm' is typically defined as an aneurysm greater than 10 cm. The aneurysm described in the leaf (14.6 cm x 12.6 cm x 14.7 cm) fits this definition, making this option equivalent to the leaf.
